en.ack.delete: I understand: this message will be shadowed (kept in the log)
en.ack.revert: I understand: revert shadows the picked message and everything after it
en.button.title: Message ops (revert / delete / branch)
en.dialog.empty: No operable messages in this session.
en.dialog.pickFirst: Step 1 · pick a message below, then choose an operation here.
en.dialog.runningWarn: ⚠ Session is running: stop it before revert / delete / branch.
en.dialog.title: Message ops
en.dock.restoreHint: Restores by replay: messages appear at the end of the session, not in their original place
en.dock.title: {n} rolled back messages
en.fork.unavailable: Built-in branch unavailable — usually because the session is running. Stop it and retry. Branching is provided by the dsh built-in session/fork.
en.op.branch: Branch into a new session from here
en.op.branchDesc: Copies everything up to and including the picked message into a new session (original untouched, non-destructive).
en.op.deleteDesc: Shadows only the picked message; everything else stays.
en.op.revert: Revert: remove this message and everything after
en.op.revertDesc: Shadows the picked message and all later visible content; the log stays append-only so context can be restored by re-sending.
en.quote.unavailable: Quote unavailable (composer locked or no full text)
en.redo.desc: Put the reverted message back into the conversation
en.redo.label: Restore the last reverted message
en.slot.revertUnmatched: Cannot locate this message seq in the log (usually the model-written summary drifted too far from the rendered text) — use the Message ops dialog instead.
en.undo.desc: Remove the last user message and put its original text back into the composer
en.undo.label: Undo last message
